§6.3.2 Charge invariance

6.3.2 Charge invariance

  • First, we would like to know what happens under charge conjugation for Dirac Spinors

  • Consider the rest frame:

    𝑢↑=(1010),𝑢↓=(0101),𝑣↑=(1010),𝑣↓=(010−1)

  • Under charge conjugation, 𝑢→−𝑖𝛾2𝑢.

    (𝑢↑)𝐿=−𝑖𝛾2(1010)=−𝑖(000−𝑖00𝑖00𝑖00𝑖000)(1010)=(0101)=𝑣↓

  • We can write several things about charge conjugation

Theorem 6.3.2.1.

  • Quantum Electrodynamics is invariant under charge conjugation

Proof.

  • For a general spinor 𝜓,

  • 𝐶:𝜓→−𝑖𝛾2𝜓*
  • 𝐶:𝜓*→−𝑖𝛾2𝜓

Lemma 6.3.2.2.

𝐶:𝜓̄𝜓→(−𝑖𝜕2𝜓)𝑇𝜕0(−𝑖𝜕2𝜓)=−𝜓𝑇𝜕2𝑇𝜕0𝜕2𝜓*=−𝜓𝑇𝜕0𝜓*=−(𝜕0)𝛼𝛽𝜓𝛼𝜓𝛽*=(𝜕𝛼)𝛼𝛽𝜓𝛼𝜓𝛽*=𝜕𝛼𝛼𝛽𝜓𝛽*𝜓𝛼=(𝜕𝛼)𝛽𝛼𝜓𝛼*𝜓𝛽=𝜓†𝛾0𝛾𝛼𝜓=𝜓̄𝜓
  • Thus, 𝐶:𝜓̄𝜓→𝜓̄𝜓

Lemma 6.3.2.3.

𝐶:𝜓̄𝜕𝜓→𝜓̄𝛾𝜓

Lemma 6.3.2.4.

𝐶:𝜓̄𝛾𝜇𝜓→−𝜓̄𝛾𝜇𝜓

Lemma 6.3.2.5.

If 𝑒𝐴𝜇𝜓̄𝛾𝜇𝜓 is charge invariant,

𝐶:𝐴𝜇→𝐴̄𝜇

Since 𝐹𝜇𝜈2 is invariant,

𝐶:𝐴𝜇→±𝐴̄𝜇

Thus, QED is charge invariant. ⁠□
